An '''aerobat''' was an athlete from a [[Species/Legends|species]] capable of flight, typically by natural means, such as wings. Non-airborne species sometimes pursued the aerobatic arts assisted by a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] or [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers. Aerobats were extreme athletes, seeking to set new records in speed, endurance, and challenging conditions. They were experts at flying maneuvers, dodging obstacles, fighting in midair, and executing power dives.
